::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/dunning_policies"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | **yes** | The name operators see. |
| `code` | `string` | **yes** | A unique code among live policies: lower-case letters, digits, '-' or '_'. |
| `description` | `string` | no | An optional description. |
| `config` | `object` | **yes** | The per-invoice dunning keys of `dunning_config` (enabled, mode, retries, final_action, dunning_period_days, skip_retries_for_hard_failures, park_hard_declines, adaptive_timing, minimum_amounts, dun_offline_invoices, dun_one_time_invoices, dun_trial_and_future_subscriptions, retries_by_method, adaptive_cadence). Absent keys take the defaults; the policy stores the full set. Business-wide keys are refused. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Created |
| `400` | Invalid body, or a business-wide key in config |
| `409` | The code is in use |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/dunning_policies" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Brightwater Analytics",
    "code": "welcome-10",
    "description": "Everything a growing team needs.",
    "config": {}
  }'
```
